concern: The person feels sad all the time and alone, and is confused about why they are unhappy despite having good friends, family, home and school.
first_advice: "I hope you can tell someone that you are feeling sad"
acknowledged_before_advice: Only exploratory questions ("I wonder if you have moments where you feel happy?") and a speculative remark that we sometimes put pressure on ourselves. Nothing reflects, validates or empathizes with their sadness, loneliness or confusion.
